summary.text: Douglas Thomas is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 72, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Cynthia Soma-Hernandez.
A trucking company owner, he previously served in the Maine House from 2004 to 2010 and in the Maine State Senate from 2010 to 2014.

paragraphs.text: Thomas is the owner of Doug Thomas Trucking, according to Ballotpedia.
He represented Maine House District 24 from 2004 to 2010 and Maine State Senate District 27 from 2010 to 2014.

In the House he served on the Transportation Committee in 2009 and 2010, on the State and Local Government and Transportation committees in 2011 and 2012, and on the Taxation Committee in 2013 and 2014.
Thomas was defeated for re-election to the Senate in 2014 by Paul Davis.
He lost the Republican primary for Maine State Senate District 4 in 2020 and finished third in the 2022 general election for Senate District 5, which Russell Black won.
He advanced from the Republican primary for House District 72 on June 9, 2026.
